title: Powertrain Solutions, Customer Innovation Engineer
jd:
We Are Bosch.
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark 

enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding 

Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, 

mobility, or industry. 
Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other. Work #LikeABosch

• Reinvent yourself: At Bosch, you will evolve. 

• Discover new directions: At Bosch, you will find your place. 

• Balance your life: At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle. 

• Celebrate success: At Bosch, we celebrate you. 

• Be yourself: At Bosch, we value values. 

• Shape tomorrow: At Bosch, you change lives.

Powertrain Solutions is a provider of diversified powertrain products and solutions across all market segments and with a product portfolio ranging from gasoline and diesel injection systems, electronics control units and software, to electrified powertrains with battery and fuel cell technologies.
We are the customer innovation management team within Bosch’s Powertrain Solutions (PS) division responsible for all technical collaboration activities with our customers in North America. We strive to support our customers on their path to a CO2-neutral and zero-emission future. We have access to a global pool of cutting-edge technology development that we utilize to engage our customer and carry these technologies from the innovation phase all the way into series production.
Responsibilities:
Take the lead: You are the engineering interface to our North American customers for internal combustion engine, hybrid powertrains and electrification, fuel cell, thermal management, electronics, software, and connected powertrain projects
You’re in charge: You manage and coordinate all internal and external stakeholders on powertrain innovation and acquisition programs
Deliver excellence: You lead cross-functional project teams to ensure portfolio alignment and customer satisfaction
Leave your footprint: You engage our customer on advanced engineering collaborations and product innovation activities
Keep us on track: You are the technical interface and voice-of-the-customer to our sales and R&D teams for pre-selling activities
Technology Domains:
Internal combustion engines
Electrification / Hybrids
Thermal Management
SW & Controls
  We are looking for engineers with...
High degree of motivation to bring innovations to fruition in direct engagement with the customer
Excellent communication and networking skills paired with high level of self-motivation and a strategic and result-oriented mindset
Ability to thrive in a diverse and multi-national organization by forming long-term relationships based on trust and commitment
Ability to adapt in dynamic and fast paced environments.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering
Deep knowledge of powertrain and thermal management technologies on system level
3-5 years of experience in an engineering, innovation or project management role with interface to external customers
Languages: English. Additional language skills, like German, French, Italian are a plus.

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.
Please note that employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.
In addition to your base compensation, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plans with an employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses.
Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: www.myboschbenefits.com. Pay ranges included in the postings generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, commission, or additional benefits.

title: Robot Operations & Reliability Engineer_PS
jd:
Bosch Powertrain Systems Co., Ltd. (RBCD), the joint venture of Robert Bosch GmbH and Weifu High Technology Group Co., Ltd., is a high tech enterprise specializing in the development, production and sales of common rail systems, exhaust gas after treatment systems, fuel cell stacks and key components. The company, based on its local R&D and project management competence, with innovative technologies, can support customers to continuously improve internal combustion engines efficiency, to reduce emission, and to accelerate the market launch of new energy products. The garget of the company is to provide the Chinese market and customers with diversified advanced powertrain products.

Job Summary
Robot Operations & Reliability Engineer
takes end-to-end responsibility for the operation management of collaborative robots — and, as the product roadmap evolves, humanoid robots — across industrial deployment scenarios,
combines cobot system know-how with software and data capabilities to build data-driven robot operation standards, shorten downtime, and improve OEE, while driving industrial-scale deployment of proven solutions for fast replication across lines and plants.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own operation KPIs of assigned collaborative robot cells — and, as the portfolio expands, humanoid robot deployments —cycle stability, and technical loss reduction.
Solve practical operations-management issues across the full system-integration-to-industrialization journey: from pilot deployment, line integration, and process stabilization through to scaled rollout and cross-site replication.
Lead structured root-cause analysis for recurring faults and long downtime events; define standard reaction playbooks and CIP with field data.
Establish data collection and visualization for robot status, alarms, and process parameters; promote early-warning mechanisms and lay the data foundation for AI/ML-driven optimization.
Standardize spare parts strategy, abnormal consumption tracking, and localization support for critical components, including emerging humanoid robot modules
Coach team members on robot operation standards, troubleshooting logic, and digital tool usage; build organizational capability for the evolving collaborative and humanoid robot portfolio.
Contribute to TPM/CIP and cross-functional initiatives such as energy efficiency, quality improvement, and cost optimization.
Coordinate with suppliers, Development, and internal teams for rapid issue closure, technical upgrades, and process change alignment; bridge the gap between product development and industrial operations.

Qualifications Requirement
Education degree:  Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Robotics, or related fields.
Total working experience  > 5 year
Related working experience >2  years
Job Relevant Knowledge and Experience
Hands-on experience with collaborative robot systems and integration in production environments; exposure to humanoid robot platforms is a strong plus.
Strong problem-solving and structured analysis skills for complex electromechanical and control issues.
Practical understanding of manufacturing KPIs (OEE, FPY, cycle time, downtime loss) and improvement methods.
Exposure to AI-assisted diagnostics, machine-learning-enabled equipment optimization, or LLM/VLM-driven robot applications is preferred.
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Fluent English both in speaking and writing

title: Account Director
jd:
Location: London, UK
Position Type: Full time, salaried

About Orennia

Orennia provides an all-in-one platform for accurate data, predictive analytics and actionable insights across the energy transition. We drive faster capital allocation decisions and help our clients maximize returns across the solar, wind, storage, power, RNG, CCUS, clean fuels and hydrogen sectors. The technology that powers Orennia’s platform delivers an unparalleled experience, distilling information into actionable insights to give our clients a competitive edge.

As the world decarbonizes its energy stack, trillions in capital need to be deployed. Global investment in the energy transition must quadruple to over $5 trillion annually to stay on the 1.5°C pathway, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency. Without accurate data and predictive analytics, developers and investors will struggle to deploy capital efficiently and maximize returns. Orennia’s platform expedites the energy transition with effective and robust information for smarter capital allocation choices.

Why Join Orennia?

People are at the heart of the best technology companies. We’ve brought together some of the industry’s top experts and brightest minds in data orchestration, analytics, software development, and industry insights to uncover opportunities where others can’t. At Orennia, you’ll become part of a collaborative culture and do work that matters. We trust and support each other, ask hard questions and solve complex problems together. Guided by a spirit of inquiry, our team has a product-driven, continuous delivery mindset to drive our innovation forward.

The Opportunity 

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth company at an exciting stage of its journey. As one of our first commercial hires in the region, you'll play a key role in establishing Orennia's presence across the UK power markets, building relationships with industry leaders, and helping renewable energy developers, investors, utilities, and infrastructure owners make better decisions through data and analytics.

You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of market experts, analysts, product leaders, and executives to shape our go-to-market strategy, influence product direction, and drive commercial growth across the region. Our mission is simple: accelerate the energy transition through better data and intelligence. Every conversation you have and every client you support contributes to the development of cleaner, more resilient energy systems around the world.

If you're entrepreneurial, intellectually curious, and excited by the opportunity to build something meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Implement the go-to-market strategy to engage leaders across renewable energy developers, IPPs, private equity firms, banking, and clean fuels developers. 

Drive Orennia's commercial growth across the UK energy market by identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.

Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across renewable energy developers, utilities, independent power producers, infrastructure funds, private equity firms, banks, and energy market participants.

Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation, contracting, and expansion.

Develop strategic account plans and tailored engagement strategies for key prospects and customers.

Partner with prospects to understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Orennia's analytics and market intelligence can support investment and commercial decisions.

Represent Orennia at industry conferences, client meetings, and market events across UK

Collaborate closely with Product, Research, Marketing, and Client Success teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Provide market feedback and client insights that help shape product development and future growth strategies.

Who You Are

You have a proven track record of success in a quota-carrying sales role selling SaaS, analytics, market intelligence, data, or technology solutions.

You have experience navigating complex enterprise sales cycles and engaging senior decision-makers.

You are comfortable building new markets, creating opportunities from scratch, and operating with a high degree of autonomy.

You possess exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage executives, investors, and technical stakeholders.

You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding complex markets, commercial dynamics, and emerging industry trends.

You have experience in, or a strong interest in, power markets, renewable energy, energy infrastructure, energy trading, or the broader energy transition.

You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and enjoy solving new challenges.

You are highly motivated, results-oriented, and excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Why You’ll Love Orennia

At Orennia, you'll join a high performing, people-focused team where everyone has a role to play. We offer our regular, full-time employees a competitive total rewards package, comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits, a savings program that includes company matching, and a learning and development budget to master your craft. In addition, we offer generous time off with regular company holidays, paid vacation days and paid sick days. 

We thank all applicants in advance for their interest and for taking the time to apply; however, only applicants invited for an interview will be contacted.

Orennia is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated fairly and with respect, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable provincial, federal, state, or local law. We believe in fostering a work environment that promotes equal opportunities for all individuals and strive to eliminate any barriers to employment and advancement. We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotions, compensation, benefits, training, and all other aspects of employment. At Orennia, diversity, inclusion, and fairness are not only important values but also critical to our success as an organization. title: Technical Sales Manager (f/m/d)
jd:
**Our Mission**
**Quest One** is a global leader in PEM electrolysis. Our goal is clear: we aim to make a significant impact in reducing greenhouse gases with our electrolyzers. Since our beginnings as a science project in 1997, we’ve grown into a subsidiary of Volkswagen Group with around 500 employees across three locations worldwide.

 **Our mission:** Drive climate protection and actively shape the energy transition. Are you ready to join us on this journey?

 **Our goal: Reduce 1% of the world’s greenhouse gases by 2050\. Quest One.**

**Your Responsibilties**
* Work closely with Sales Managers to secure electrolysis plant supply contracts for complex and high\-value business opportunities.
* Analyze customer RFIs and RFQs and develop tailored solutions based on Quest One’s products and services.
* Review customer technical specifications, initiate deviation lists, and lead technical clarification discussions with customers and EPC partners.
* Lead and coordinate the bid management process, including governance gates and Large Project Approval (LPA), while driving continuous process improvements.
* Utilize and optimize key tools such as Salesforce, SAP and LCOH models to support commercial activities and decision\-making.
* Coordinate cross\-functional bid support from Project Application Engineering, Costing, Product Management, Legal and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment, progress and adherence to deadlines.
* Prepare high\-quality commercial and technical proposals independently, documenting assumptions, cost calculations, guarantees and key inputs.
* Manage bid timelines and ensure accurate and timely submission of proposals.
* Present proposals and bid strategies to customers in collaboration with Sales Managers.
* Support and participate in commercial negotiations with customers and partners to successfully close transactions.
* Lead the project handover process to the Project Execution team upon contract award.
* Conduct post\-bid reviews with Sales and relevant functions to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.

**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Energy Engineering or a similar field.
* Several years of experience with large industrial process plants in plant design and/or EPC project execution, preferably within the renewable energy or industrial gases sectors.
* Proven technical, commercial and contractual expertise.
* Experience as a Technical Sales Manager, Technical Sales Engineer, Sales Application Engineer or Sales Project Manager.
* Knowledge of hydrogen markets and applications or a strong interest in hydrogen energy.
* Cross\-cultural competence and experience working in international environments.
* Strong project management skills.
* Proactive, self\-driven and capable of working autonomously and responsibly.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Business\-fluent English (C1/C2\); German and/or a Nordic language are considered an advantage.

**Why Quest One?**
* **OWNERSHIP** – We grow together with Quest One, and you have the opportunity to take active responsibility.
* **ONE TEAM** – A strong team that sticks together and shapes the future.
* **LEARNING** – Personal growth is our focus, with numerous development opportunities.

**Your Benefits**
* Flexible work arrangements for a good work\-life\-balance.
* Regular updates and transparent communication through our town\-hall\-meetings.
* Buddy program as part of onboarding.
* Daily lunch allowance.
* Attractive employee discounts with Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.
* Free drinks, fruit, and a JobRad for a greener commute.

Do you want to help shape the future with us?  

Then apply now at Quest One and become part of a team that truly makes a difference.

*At Quest One, we’re looking for people who want to actively help shape the future. What matters to us is your talent and motivation—your background, skin color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability doesn’t matter. Our diversity makes us stronger, more creative, and more successful. Together, we grow as a team in an inclusive and sustainable environment where discrimination has no place. Join a global company that values diversity and is committed to equal opportunities.*

title: Project Engineer (m/f/i) - Power Generation
jd:
The **Project Engineer – Power Generation Systems (UL 2200 / UL 6200\)** is responsible for conducting technical evaluations, certification assessments, and project management activities for power generation equipment, generator assemblies, and power products.

Location: ***Neu\-Isenburg/Germany***

Work arrangement: ***Hybrid***

  
* Determines project scope, develops a preliminary plan of investigation, and determines project specifications such as cost, time, and sample requirements by analyzing client input, available supplemental data, and product construction.
* Projects may include frequent travel to conduct or witness tests at client sites.
* Communicates with clients to discuss technical issues, explain UL procedures and requirements, convey project cost, and negotiate completion date and sample requirements.
* Acts to address client concerns and to resolve client issues.
* Provides technical assistance to clients in reference to product inspection and follow\-up services.
* Establishes appropriate test programs by reviewing files and manufacturer's information, examining samples, and applying UL requirements.
* Notifies client of any areas in which the product is not in compliance with UL requirements or of any changes in project scope or specifications.
* Coordinates laboratory activities by preparing data sheets and instructions to technicians, scheduling and reviewing work of Laboratory Technicians and support staff and establishing completion dates.
* Coordinates administrative aspects of project management.
* Serves as Project Handler of record and may sign as Reviewer of record as assigned.
* Communicates project status and results to clients through frequent contact and by preparing reports.
* Prepares Follow\-Up Service Procedures and information pages.
* Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
* Resolves engineering issues associated with Variation Notices by analyzing and reporting on the acceptability of the variations.
* Develops special test methods and test equipment.
* Coordinates and/or performs File Reviews.
* May represent UL at industry related functions such as seminars and trade shows.
* May provide direction as a Primary Designated Engineer or Designated Engineer for specific product categories.
* May directs and review work of assigned staff.
* May train office, field, and/or laboratory staff and entry\-level engineers.
* Provides technical assistance to laboratory and/or field staff.
* Read and follow the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and follow all physical and digital security practices.
* Performs other duties as directed.

  
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related technical discipline and a minimum of four years of relevant engineering experience.
* Experience within one of the following disciplines: Genset assemblies (e.g. electrical generating equipment driven by gasoline, LP\-gas, natural gas or diesel\-fueled internal combustion engines), Gas turbines, electrical generators (low, medium and high voltage), controllers in use of power production (from smaller control units up to larger control panels), hydrogen generator (e.g. Solid Oxide Electrolyzer (SOEC) hydrogen generators that electrolyze water to produce hydrogen)
* Detailed knowledge of the technical vocabulary common to power generation systems, industrial control equipment, rotating electrical machines, electrical protection systems, and safety\-related control functions.
* Preferred to have working knowledge of conformity standards in use in area of expertise. ANSI/CAN/UL/ULC 2200, ANSI/CAN/UL/ULC 6200, UL 1004 series, UL 508A, NFPA 70, NFPA 37, NFPA 110, and related certification requirements.
* Ability to independently evaluate complex products, conduct compliance assessments, review risk analyses, and determine certification requirements.
* Demonstrated project management skills, including planning, execution, testing coordination, customer communication, and technical decision\-making.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders.

title: Studentische Hilfskraft "Unterstützung der Laborarbeit unter Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheit"
jd:
Die Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.

Als eines der weltweit größten Solarforschungsinstitute leistet das Fraunhofer\-Institut für Solare Energiesysteme ISE einen wesentlichen Beitrag für eine nachhaltige, wirtschaftliche, sichere und sozial gerechte Energieversorgung weltweit. Unser Ziel ist es, die Energiewende mit konkret umsetzbaren technologischen Lösungen voranzutreiben – durch exzellente Forschungsergebnisse, erfolgreiche Industriekooperationen und Firmenausgründungen. Hierfür forschen wir mit unseren rund 1\.300 Mitarbeitenden in den vier Schwerpunkten Energiebereitstellung, Energieverteilung, Energiespeicherung und Energienutzung. Die hochmoderne FuE\-Infrastruktur des Fraunhofer ISE mit 22 300 m² Laborfläche ermöglicht Spitzenforschung auf internationalem Niveau.

  

**Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung**

Du möchtest dazu beitragen, wissenschaftliche Arbeiten sicher zu gestalten? In der Abteilung „Brennstoffzelle“ charakterisieren und entwickeln wir in unseren Laboren sowohl Einzelzellen als auch Brennstoffzellenstapel und \-systeme. Um den ordnungsgemäßen Ablauf der Arbeiten sowie die Arbeitssicherheit in den Laboren zu gewährleisten, ist es notwendig, den bestehenden Standard zu pflegen. Mit Deiner Unterstützung vor Ort stärken wir die Arbeitssicherheit in unseren Laboren. Damit trägst Du dazu bei, dass die Wissenschaftler\*innen in unserer Abteilung ihre Projekte sicher und zuverlässig bearbeiten können.

Für unsere Gruppe „Brennstoffzelle: Testsysteme“ suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine studentische Hilfskraft für die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

* Du bereitest wissenschaftliche Experimente unter Einhaltung arbeitssicherheitstechnischer Vorgaben vor.
* Du analysierst Proben und stellst die ordnungsgemäße Verwendung sowie Dokumentation von Chemikalien sicher.
* Du dokumentierst Arbeits\- und Versuchsergebnisse sorgfältig und nachvollziehbar.
* Du wirkst an der Verbesserung von Ablagestrukturen für laborbezogene Ergebnisse mit.
* Du unterstützt bei der Materialbeschaffung für die Durchführung wissenschaftlicher Projekte und holst hierfür Angebote ein.

  

**Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein**

* Du studierst Chemie, Pharmazie, Sicherheitswesen, Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung.
* Du bringst analytisches und technisches Interesse mit und möchtest Deine Kenntnisse in diesen Bereichen weiter ausbauen.
* Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Labortätigkeiten und deren Dokumentation und bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Labor.

title: Bautechniker:in (m/w/d)
jd:
#### **Deine Aufgaben**

* Planung von Hoch\- und Tiefbauumgebungen einschließlich Tie\-in\-Punkten, Schnittstellen, Tragwerken und Rohrbrücken für verfahrenstechnische Anlagen in Chemieparks und Umsetzung der Anbindung unserer Industrieanlage
* Tragwerksplanung sowie Betreuung von Statik und tragenden Bauteilen
* Planungen von Rohrleitungen
* Infrastrukturplanung inkl. benötigter Gutachten (z.B. Kampfmittelerkundung, Bodenzustandsbericht, …)
* Betreuung der Bauplanung sowie des Bauantrags und Genehmigungsverfahrens
* Betreuung und Koordination von Lieferungen sowie Lieferantenmanagement inkl. Bewertung von technischen Änderungen
* Begleitung und Koordinierung von Bauausführung auf der Baustelle, inklusive Hoch\- und Tiefbau sowie Grabungsarbeiten, Anlageninbetriebnahmen, Anlagenumbauten und \-abnahme an verfahrenstechischen Anlagen in Chemieparks sowie Betreuung der Mängelbehebung
* Datenmanagement wie z.B. 3D Gesamtanlagenmodelle, Layout, Baupläne, Genehmigungsunterlagen, Rohrleitungspläne oder Schaltpläne

#### **Dein Profil**

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (z.B. staatl. gepr. Bautechniker:in)
* Hohe Reisebereitschaft
* Bereits praktische Erfahrung auf Baustellen und im Anlagengeschäft sowie in der Inbetriebnahme großer industrieller Versorgungsanlagen
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Planung und Genehmigung von großindustriellem Anlagenbau in Chemieparks sind von Vorteil
* Erste Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Vermessung, Geotechnik, Erdarbeiten, Bewehrungspläne, Schalpläne oder Fachwerksgutachten sind von Vorteil
* Erfahrung im Lieferantenmanagement
* Kenntnisse über VOB (Vergabe\- und Vertragsordnung für Bauleistungen) sowie HOAI (Honorarordnung für Architekten und Ingenieure) von Vorteil
* Fachkenntnisse zu den DIN\-Normen im Stahl\-, Beton\-, Erd\- und Tiefbau sind ebenfalls von Vorteil
* Ausgeprägte Hands\-on\-Mentalität und Freude daran, Verantwortung in einem Umfeld mit vielen offenen Fragen zu übernehmen
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke für die Koordination zahlreicher interner und externer Schnittstellen
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. B2\) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

#### **Warum wir?**

* Jährliches Budget für fachliche Weiterbildungen
* Ein engagiertes Startup\-Team, in dem sich alle als Teil der Firma begreifen
* Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und großer Gestaltungsfreiraum in den Aufgaben
* Gesundheits\- oder Mobilitätszuschlag
* Ein Start\-up mit positivem Impact auf Gesellschaft und Umwelt bei gleichzeitig hohem kommerziellem Potenzial
* Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

#### **Über uns**

Cyclize defossilisiert die chemische Industrie durch das Recycling von gemischten Kunststoffabfällen und CO2, um Synthesegas (ein Gasgemisch aus Kohlenmonoxid und Wasserstoff) herzustellen. Dieses Synthesegas dient als Grundbaustein für höherwertige Chemikalien und wird zur Herstellung von Kunststoffen, Methanol, Wasserstoff und E\-Fuels verwendet. Bislang wird Synthesegas immer noch durch die lineare Nutzung fossiler Ressourcen wie Erdgas gewonnen. Unser innovatives Verfahren ermöglicht es, fossile Ressourcen durch Abfallstoffe zu ersetzen. Damit ermöglichen wir die Kohlenstoff\-Kreislaufwirtschaft und vermeiden bis 2050 jährlich Hunderte von Megatonnen CO2\-Emissionen.  

  

Gefördert durch das BMWK, folgefinanziert durch VC Investoren  

  

Gegründet im Mai 2023, mittlerweile ein starkes Team von 20 Personen  

Standort in Stuttgart Degerloch und Vaihingen  

Ausgezeichnet durch Science4Life, Falling Walls, StartupBW, Vision Award, Stuttgarter Innovationspreis, CyberOne Hightech Award, TechTour NRW und weitere.  

  

Werde auch Du Teil unserer Mission.
